mechanism: Both drugs can cause nephrotoxicity and myelosuppression; zidovudine may increase zoledronic acid exposure through renal impairment, and concurrent use elevates risk of anemia and bone marrow suppression.
action: Monitor renal function, complete blood counts, and hemoglobin levels closely; ensure adequate hydration before zoledronic acid infusion and consider dose adjustments based on creatinine clearance.
